RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the December 12, 2006/Agrahayana 21, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Impact of English on medium culture
†*281.SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the education being imparted in English
medium in schools is spoiling the life style,
language, customs and traditions of people
of various communities;
(b) if so, the efforts being made to check
the same; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Amount deposited in National
Investment Fund
*282. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are parking the
money in the National Investment Fund
(NIF);
(b) if so, the details of such money
parked in NIF during the last two years,
year-wise;
(c) whether Government are taking up
any developmental projects with the
money;
(d) if so, the details of such activities
undertaken during the last two years; and
(e) the present status of NIF?
Completion of Tillari Irrigation
Project
*283. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
WATER RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Tillari Irrigation Project
in Maharashtra has been completed;
(b) if so, the land proposed to be
irrigated under the project;
(c) the land presently brought under
cultivation, both in Goa and Maharashtra;
(d) whether the displaced persons have
been rehabilitated; and
(e) if so, the details of the scheme for
their rehabilitation?

89
Tenure based appointments in ONGC
*284. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether field operators in drilling
and work over rigs are being appointed on
tenure basis in Western Region in ONGC;
(b) whether there is any provision of
tenure basis engagement in the recruitment
policy of ONGC;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether the policy of tenure basis
engagement has been accepted by the
concerned unions/associations;
(e) whether the present tenure based
appointments against regular posts are as
per requirement; and
(f) the terms and conditions of tenure
basis appointees?
Emergency landing of AI aircrafts
*285. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during the
last ten months, four Air India aircrafts
suffered damage like tyre burst,
malfunctioning of weather radar or aircraft
engine, which forced the pilots to make
emergency landings in Mumbai-Delhi, thus
causing unnecessary tension amongst
passengers and Air India suffering a huge
financial loss thereby;
(b) if so, the reasons for malfunctioning
of weather radar, engines, etc. since rigid
pre-takeoff tests are always enforced;
and
(c) what steps have been taken to ensure
that such situations do not recur?
New open sky regime
*286. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether pushing ahead with PM's
offer for an open sky in SAARC region,
India has sent out detailed letters outlining
the offer to all SAARC members except
Pakistan and has even extended fifty
freedom rights for flights operating within
the region;
(b) whether his Ministry has expressed
reservations about joining the open sky
agreement of ASEAN by 2010 and wants
to join regime only after 2012;
(c) whether most of the ASEAN
countries plan to follow an open sky regime
from 2010 and have invited India to be part
of the planned liberalisation;
(d) if so, the main reasons for the same;
and
(e) whether any agreement in this regard
has been reached?
Filling up of vacancies in IA in
Chennai
*287. SHRI SK. KHABIR UDDIN
AHMED: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of vacant posts in
Southern Regional Establishment of Indian
Airlines in Chennai, post-wise;
(b) by when, these vacancies will be
filled up; and
(c) whether casual labours are being
engaged against the vacancies?

90
Opening of new agriculture accounts
*288. SHRI SUDARSHAN
AKARAPU: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of new agriculture
accounts opened by banks during the last
three years, year-wise;
(b) what are the targets set for opening
new agriculture accounts during the current
financial year (2006-07) and the
achievements made there against as on
31st October, 2006; and
(c) the total amount of agriculture credit
disbursed by banks during the last three
years vis-a-vis the targets set by
Government/RBI?
Supply of gas to RGTPP
*289. DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND

Facilities to physically challenged
passengers
2104. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI JAYA BACHCHAN:
SHRIMATI PREMA CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that DGCA has
asked domestic airlines to be sensitive to
the needs of physically challenged
following a litany of complaints from
passengers;
(b) if so, the details of the directions
issued in this regard;
(c) whether the directions have been
implemented; if so, to what extent; and
(d) if not, the reasons for non-
implementation?
Land for development of airports
†2105. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of airports for which land
has been given to Airports Authority of
India for development by the State
Government of Madhya Pradesh;
(b) whether the work on these airports
have been completed; and
(c) if not, the reasons for non-
completion of work and by when the work
is likely to be completed?
Improvement in baggage screening at
airport
2106. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have received proposals from various
quarters for better baggage screening at
airports;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that India is
one of the few countries where passengers
baggage-to-be checked is subject to pre-
screening before being presented at the
airlines check-in counter?
Revival of closed airports
2107. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the airports in the
country closed during the last few years;

481
(b) the reasons for closure of these
airports;
(c) whether any such airports have so
far been revived by Government; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
US assistance in civil aviation sector
2108. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Federal Aviation
Authority of the United States and the
Ministry signed a Memorandum of
Agreement paving the way for technical
assistance from US on a host of aviation
related matters;
(b) if so, what are the other main
features of the agreement;
(c) whether MoA is an umbrella
agreement and would have many
subordinate agreements as and when signed
with different agencies; and
(d) if so, to what extent the agreement
will be helpful to boost aviation
management?
Simplification of licence for pilots
2109. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is acute
shortage of trained pilots in Indian aviation
industry;
(b) if so, how many pilots will be
required in the coming 2-3 years;
(c) whether it is  also a fact that
Government are planning to simplify the
licence of pilots under new training system;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Joint venture for infrastructure
2110. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
and the Ministry of Railways are together
planning to invest Rs. 4 lakh crores in
building the infrastructure of the country
over the next five years;
(b) if so, the details of this ambitious
plan;
(c) what is the share of his Ministry in
the total expenditure; and
(d) how the Ministry is planning to
pool the resources for this mega plan?
Delay in AI-188 flight
2111. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether a broken pipe was found in
the toilet of aircraft on AI-188 flight which
took off from Toronto airport on the 18th
September, 2006 and had to return to
Toronto after an hour flight as a result
thereof;
(b) if so, whether the incident has been
probed; and
(c) if so, the findings thereof and  the
action taken thereon?
Promotion of regional airlines
2112. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that to promote

482
regional airlines, Government are planning
to exempt their carriers from paying airport
and navigation charges in the first five years
of operation;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government are also contemplating to
extend subsidy to airlines on bidding basis
to promote regional connectivity including
the North East and Jammu and Kashmir;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
New airport at Ludhiana

(a) whether Government have given the
